zoe (People Ops): Quick one  Candidate asked if we cover visa courier fees and same-day COVID tests for international interviews. Also question about tipping for taxis/porters when candidate pays cash. Any guidance?

mike (Recruiting Ops): Short: visa courier fees are reimbursable with invoice and proof of payment (attach tracking/receipt). COVID tests for travel are reimbursable only if required by destination/airline and with proof of payment. Personal convenience tests (not required) are not covered.

Ravi (Finance): Add: tipping reimbursed up to 20% of fare for taxis/rideshares, or $8 for porters per occurrence. For cash tips, the candidate can upload a photo of a handwritten tip receipt or include a short attestation; small tips (<$15) without receipts may be approved with hiring manager sign-off.

anna (Hiring Manager): Candidate booked refundable flight and got a travel credit after refund. We reimbursed the charge, but how do we handle credit?

Ravi (Finance): If candidate gets a credit/refund after reimbursement, they must return excess or finance will offset it against future reimbursements. Document the refund email and card credits. We reimburse net amounts.

mike (Recruiting Ops): Also for cross-border expenses: ask candidate to upload the card statement showing the foreign charge and conversion rate if possible. Finance needs evidence of the exact amount charged in USD.

travel-bot: TravelPolicyBot: Reminder: Candidate travel claims must be submitted within 30 days. Required attachments: e-ticket/boarding pass or itinerary, proof of payment (card statement or confirmation), itemized lodging receipt if applicable, invoices for visa/courier. COVID tests must show test type, date, result (if requested) and payment.

zoe (People Ops): Edge case: candidate used a friends loyalty points to book hotel; friend paid taxes/fees. Can we reimburse those taxes/fees?

Ravi (Finance): Taxes/fees paid by friend can be reimbursed with proof of payment and a short attestation from the friend showing the transaction. Prefer candidate bookings on their own card but allow exceptions with documentation. No reimbursements for points used to cover room rate itself.

anna (Hiring Manager): What about incidental purchases on company card during interview (coffee/snacks for candidate)?

mike (Recruiting Ops): Small incidentals on company card are fine; note attendee list. Avoid purchasing alcohol for non-business guests.

zoe (People Ops): Any caps on seat upgrades or expedited visas?

Ravi (Finance): Upgrades require pre-approval from recruiting@redwood. If upgrade cost > $150 above economy, get written approval. Expedited visa/courier fees are reimbursable if required for interview timing but attach justification.

mike (Recruiting Ops): Copy/paste template for expense app: ```Expense title: Candidate travel - [Name]
Total: $XXX.XX
Items:
- Flight (e-ticket attached) $YYY.YY
- Visa courier (invoice attached) $AA.AA
- COVID test (if required) $BB.BB
- Ground transfer/tip (receipt/attestation attached) $CC.CC
Notes: Candidate travel approved by recruiting@redwood on 2026-04-12. Guest/partner costs excluded.```

zoe (People Ops): Thanks all  Ill update the recruiting checklist and add a sentence about tip caps and visa courier docs. If anyone has a weird corner case (e.g., paid parking by cash at border crossing) drop it here and we'll confirm next steps.
